title: close removes a landed item's scratch directory, including a baseline clone a worker made there, which neither the worker nor the orchestrator could delete
goal: backlog.py close (and tidy) remove the scratch directory of each landed item of the sprint (scratch_dir/<id>), a git clone inside it included, printing removed or 'close: kept <path>: <reason>', since a headless worker and the orchestrator are refused rm -rf and a baseline clone under _cache/scratch/<id>/base outlives the sprint.

run:
import sys, os, json, tempfile, subprocess, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_base
ENV = dict(os.environ, GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='a', GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='a@example.com', GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='a', GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='a@example.com')
g = lambda t, *a: subprocess.run(['git', *a], cwd=t, env=ENV, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
t = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()).resolve(); d = t/'_backlog'; d.mkdir()
w = lambda o: (d/(o['id']+'.json')).write_text(bl_base.canonical(o))
w({'id':'SP-aaaaaaaa','kind':'sprint','title':'s','status':'active','goal':'g'})
w({'id':'ST-aaaaaaa2','kind':'story','title':'t','status':'done','sprint':'SP-aaaaaaaa','priority':'P3','rank':0,'goal':'g'})
g(t,'init','-q','-b','main'); g(t,'add','-A'); g(t,'commit','-q','-m','plan')
mine, other = t/'_cache'/'scratch'/'ST-aaaaaaa2', t/'_cache'/'scratch'/'ST-zzzzzzz2'
for p in (mine/'base', other):
    p.mkdir(parents=True); (p/'f.txt').write_text('x')
g(mine/'base','init','-q','-b','main'); g(mine/'base','add','-A'); g(mine/'base','commit','-q','-m','base clone')
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',str(t),'close','SP-aaaaaaaa'],capture_output=True,text=True)
sys.exit(0 if r.returncode == 0 and not mine.exists() and other.exists() else 1)

notes: Retrospective of SP-7n3d4jte (2026-10-12): the ST-b27c527d worker made a baseline clone at _cache/scratch/ST-b27c527d/base to time the suite before its change; its rm -rf was denied, and so was the orchestrator's, so the clone outlives the sprint in the orchestrator worktree. Touches are a guess: the planner runs referrers on close's cleanup first. Recurred SP-qlpfcgs2: rm -rf denied for BG-w6z2zc6r's scratch clone trim, ST-iai37tjr's exp and base clones, and a .venv uv made in ST-owyktog7's worktree.
